Phill, saw NeoGov was acquired by EQT and CPP and named to the 2026 GovTech 100, with Vetted adding 250-plus customers in under 18 months.

New ownership plus a breakout product usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so reps drop the research and CRM work and spend time closing: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for NeoGov off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Phill, quick follow-up for NeoGov.

Under new PE ownership, growth targets tend to jump before the team grows. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings NeoGov needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Phill, last bit of proof for NeoGov.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.
